title: Experts disagree on new src/speed-report/transcripts.ts
context:
Chief architect: Not a real disagreement: all three are adopted. An injectable transcripts root is the precondition for the #756 fixture test (tests/fixtures/speed-report/) and keeps CI off the developer's home folder; streaming line by line reuses the existing chunked scanner scanTranscriptLines in src/cost/transcript-usage.ts; the error-path cases come straight from 'a project with no transcripts prints no transcript rows and exits 0'. Pick this option to accept the set.

Target: new src/speed-report/transcripts.ts
- performance-analyst: transcripts are read line by line as a stream, one file at a time, never whole into memory, because a single session transcript can be hundreds of megabytes
- qa-engineer: The transcripts root (today ~/.claude/projects) must be injectable (option or env) so unit and fixture tests never read the real home directory; a test that reads the developer's own transcripts passes locally and fails in CI.
- qa-engineer: Error paths each get a case and none throws: a tool_use with no matching tool_result (interrupted) is dropped, a malformed JSONL line is skipped, a subagent file with no agent-*.meta.json counts as unknown type, a ledger with only rows lacking recorded_at gives an empty window, and an empty feature-evidence folder prints a header and exits 0.
